sections.Profile:
The "Golden Bells" pinball machine, released by Williams Electronic Manufacturing Corporation on February 16, 1959, is a single-player electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1959
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Good Times, Wood Rail, Original Theme, Bells, Music, Single level playfield
